policy_presence.summary: No accepted current canonical conclusion is established here; local evidence candidates and original tool records remain pending review.

ai_disclosure.summary: Students should acknowledge how GenAI contributed to submitted work; uncredited AI-generated output may constitute plagiarism.

coursework.summary: Students must follow the instructor’s rules for each course; AI access is not coursework permission.

exams.summary: The 2026 Academic Conduct Code governs unauthorized conduct in examinations; the specific exam instructions determine permitted aids.

privacy_data_entry.summary: TerrierGPT is supported for confidential data, not restricted-use data; other tools have distinct security classifications.

academic_integrity.summary: The Academic Conduct Code effective July 1, 2026 includes generative AI in its plagiarism provisions, with specific schools excluded.

approved_tools.summary: BU’s tool directory distinguishes accounts, licences and data classes. Confirm the terms of the particular service; an available account does not permit graded use.

named_ai_services.summary: No accepted current canonical conclusion is established here; local evidence candidates and original tool records remain pending review.

teaching_guidance.summary: AIDA recommends explicit syllabus rules, early explanation and consistent misconduct enforcement; these are recommendations.

research_guidance.summary: Faculty and staff should verify AI outputs and disclose use in documents and publications; specific publisher policies still apply.

security_procurement.summary: TerrierGPT excludes restricted-use data; Microsoft 365 Copilot has a different data classification. Service licensing and data approval do not grant assessment permission.
